metadata.agent_last_message:
Implemented a full Node.js IGES CLI at [output/main.js](/workspace/output/main.js) (no external dependencies), with compatibility entry points:

- [main.js](/workspace/main.js) → symlink to `output/main.js` so `node main.js ...` works
- [output/iges](/workspace/output/iges) → executable symlink name `iges`

Supported subcommands and contracts:

- `parse`, `write`, `query`, `eval`, `roundtrip`
- Correct exit codes (`0/1/2`)
- Required diagnostic JSON envelope on failures
- `write`/`roundtrip` failure diagnostics to stderr, with `--output` unwritten
- 80-column fixed-format IGES writing with deterministic one-pass normalization/fixed-point behavior
- Global section defaults, delimiter handling (including explicit/custom delimiters), DE parsing/writing, PD parsing/writing
- Cross-reference validation for `view`, `xform_matrix`, `label_display`
- Required invalid-input checks (`negative entity type`, `param_line_count`, required positive global numerics, degenerate Type 110 line, missing required sections, etc.)
- Entity catalog support for all listed 87 type IDs
- `eval` implemented for required curve/surface sets, with transformation-matrix application order and required `t/s` flag behavior

Validation I ran locally:

- `node --check /workspace/output/main.js`
- End-to-end `write -> parse -> eval -> query -> roundtrip`
- Roundtrip fixed-point check (`roundtrip(roundtrip(file))` byte-identical)
- Error envelope behavior for invalid query/eval/write cases
- Custom global delimiters parse/write check (`|` and `!`)
